response.justification: The candidate is a strong, versatile senior engineer, but does not meet the core requirements of this role. His C++ experience is limited to a ~6-month stint at National Instruments in 2014–2015 and a university thesis, far short of the mandated 5–10 years of hands-on Windows C++ development. He has no fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain experience (RIDE Capital was a fintech/investment-adjacent role but built with Node/TypeScript), and no evident SQL Server or Oracle depth. His recent stack (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang) diverges significantly from the job's profile.
strengths: Strong overall engineering fundamentals with low-latency, high-throughput systems experience (DLang at Dunnhumby)
Solid CI/CD, testing, and DevOps practices (TDD, trunk-based development, Docker, Kubernetes)
Broad polyglot background including some C/C++, Java, and SQL exposure
concerns: Only ~6 months of professional C++ experience, over a decade ago, versus the required 5–10 years
No fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain expertise
No demonstrated SQL Server/Oracle or Windows-platform development experience

key_factors.factor: No capital markets / fixed income domain knowledge
Strong general engineering and performance systems background
